text:
La Gazzetta dello Sport
The capital of records
10,000 fans for the leaders away at Sassuolo. Gasp against Cagliari: challenges between the Azzurri Pisilli and Romano.
Give us the derby
Thuram is the leader and a renewal for him is ready: Pulisic is the key player and will remain with the Rossoneri until 2031.
Kane, the new king, is English
Mbappé second, Yamal only third. PSG is the best club.
Genius coups with Vlasic and Paz
Corriere dello Sport
Rino, 10,000 away, Frattesi commands.
Davide the leader: double derby against Sassuolo and Aquilani, chasing the 8th win in nine games.
Gasp: ‘Roma have no limits’
Dybala recovers and can go on the bench. There’s Mora. Balerdi starts. Molina on the left, Lulli tied down: he has signed for five more seasons.
Double blow
Napoli decimated: two-game ban for Allegri, and two more muscle injuries
Allegri suspended; Badiashile and Spinazzola injured.
The coach punished after his red card against Roma: he’ll miss Monza. The club is appealing to get him back for the Juve match. The Frenchman will remain out for a month; the wing-back will return after the break. Rrahmani recovers; Marianucci and Lobotka are ready.
Ballon d’Or to Kane
‘Mourinho, a football lesson.’
Inter in Venice with Pio and Bonny
Chivu rotates ahead of the derby: Calha and Barella on the bench too
Milan emergency: eight out
Rabiot, Moreira, Gila still out. Injury for Loftus-Cheek.
Juve, Kolo Muani risks being dropped
Spalletti could leave him out against Genoa to try to motivate him
Tuttosport
‘Toro: Hunger, hunger, hunger.’
Wolte surpasses Kolo
The hierarchies in the Juve attack can change: The struggling Frenchman risks remaining out against Genoa and Balogun in January…
Ahead with the 3-5-2 until the break: the decision to play Alajbegovic behind the German would be finalised to revive Muani ahead of Napoli. Meanwhile, the American is a candidate, with Sorloth in the background. Wiafe between Bianconeri and…Azzurri.
Allegri, two-game ban, Gasp: ‘An unfortunate remark.’
Malagò, Galliani and time wasted
Kane bites the Ballon d’Or.
digest_he:
עיתוני הספורט המובילים באיטליה, ובהם גאזטה דלו ספורט וקוריירה דלו ספורט, מקדישים את כותרותיהם למספר התפתחויות בולטות בכדורגל האירופי והמקומי. במרכז הדיווחים עומדת זכייתו של הארי קיין בתואר כדור הזהב, כאשר קיליאן אמבאפה דורג שני ולאמין ימאל שלישי.

בזירה המקומית, נאפולי סופגת מכה קשה עם עונש השעיה לשני משחקים למאמן אלגרי ושתי פציעות שריר חדשות לסגל. כמו כן, נרשמים דיווחים על היערכות הקבוצות השונות לקראת המשחקים הקרובים בליגה, כולל מצבת הפציעות ברומא, מילאן ויובנטוס.
